title: Joiner-to-Leaver Lifecycle and Benefit Activation Guide
author: Aisha Patel
body:
Summary

This guide documents the end-to-end lifecycle for contributors at Redwood from offer acceptance through offboarding, with an emphasis on deterministic benefit activation windows, role/level mapping for career conversations, and the internal toolchain provisioning and deprovisioning runbooks. The objective is a repeatable, auditable process that reduces time-to-productivity and minimizes security exposure at transitions.

Scope

- Applies to all full-time employees, contractors on >90 day engagements, and long-term interns.
- Excludes short-term contractors (<90 days) who receive a reduced provisioning set (see Appendix B).
- Covers People Ops, IT/Security, Hiring Manager, and New Joiner responsibilities.

Key Principles

1. Predictable windows: benefit enrollments and device ordering follow fixed activation windows to avoid ad-hoc exceptions.
2. Least privilege: grant minimal access required for role; escalate within a 7-day review window if additional access is needed.
3. Measurement: track time-to-first-PR and time-to-healthplan-enrollment as primary metrics.

Benefits Activation Timeline (standard new hire)

| Day \t| Action \t| Owner \t| Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Offer signed (Day 0) | Initiate HRIS profile and payroll setup | People Ops | Triggers device order, benefits vendor integration |
| Day 1 (Start) | Slack, Google Workspace, Okta account created; laptop delivery scheduled | IT / Onboarding Bot | Email welcome + 1:1 with manager scheduled
| Day 1–7 | Access to internal docs, GitHub read access, and basic tooling | IT & Hiring Manager | Request additional repos via access request workflow (see Runbook)
| Day 14 | Benefits orientation invite (health, equity, commuter) | People Ops | Live orientation session + recorded replay available
| Day 30 | Health & retirement enrollment window opens (30 day window) | People Ops / Benefits Vendor | Elections processed by payroll cutoff (see Payroll Schedule)
| Day 90 | Full benefits vesting & long-term incentive eligibility (if applicable) | People Ops / Finance | Probation review and permanent benefits confirm
| Exit notice | Offboarding workflow initiated immediately | Hiring Manager & People Ops | See Offboarding checklist below |

Role and Career Ladder Mapping (overview)

- Leveling taxonomy: IC1, IC2, IC3, IC4, Staff, Principal; EM1, EM2, EM3 for managers.
- Core signals used in leveling: scope of impact, independent execution, mentorship, cross-team influence, technical breadth.
- Leveling conversation cadence: initial calibration at offer, checkpoint at 6 months, formal promotion cycle annually.

Level snapshot table (examples for engineering roles)

| Level | Typical yrs experience | Expected outcomes | Evidence artifacts |
|---|---:|---|---|
| IC1 | 0–2 | Delivers scoped features, reliable QA | PRs, code reviews, mentor feedback |
| IC2 | 2–4 | Owns components, mentors juniors | Design docs, cross-team deliveries |
| IC3 | 4–7 | Leads major subsystems, sets tech direction | RFCs, postmortems, measurable metrics |
| Staff+ | 7+ | Company-level influence, architecture strategy | Roadmaps, cross-org initiatives, published standards |

Provisioning Runbook (Access provisioning for new joiners)

Owners: People Ops (trigger), IT/Security (provision), Hiring Manager (verify).

1. People Ops actions (Day 0–1)
   - Add hire to HRIS with role, start date, manager, location, compensation band.
   - Kick off onboarding_bot job: /onboard create --name "First Last" --team "Platform" --start YYYY-MM-DD

2. IT actions (automated where possible)
   - Okta: create account, assign base groups (employee, engineering, nyc-office).
   - Google Workspace: create mailbox and calendar, set aliases.
   - GitHub: add to org and default team with read access; request elevated write access via /access-request.
   - Laptop: Create ticket for device procurement and set delivery SLA = 72 hours for US, 5 business days for EMEA.

3. Hiring Manager verification (Day 1–3)
   - Confirm the new joiner can access their repository, Slack, and onboarding docs.
   - Schedule 1:1 onboarding agenda (people ops template attached).

Access request escalation

- If write or admin access is required, follow the three-step authorization: manager approval in Jira ticket -> Security review (48 hours) -> IT finalization.
- Emergency access: manager opens a high-priority ticket and tags security-oncall; temporary elevated access expires after 72 hours unless extended.

Offboarding checklist (runbook for voluntary and involuntary exits)

Immediate actions (within 1 hour of notice)

1. Hiring Manager: confirm last working day and notify People Ops.
2. People Ops: mark HRIS record as pending offboard; communicate final payroll and benefits cessation dates.
3. IT/Security: schedule deprovisioning tasks as per schedule below.

Deprovisioning schedule

| Timing | Action | Responsible | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Last working day (immediate) | Revoke Okta SSO, Google sign-in, and Slack access | IT/Security | Ensure ACLs removed from privileged groups first |
| T+1 day | Archive GitHub access and transfer ownership of repos | Team Lead / IT | Maintain audit of transferred artifacts |
| T+3 days | Reclaim devices and recover corporate data | IT Asset Mgmt | Follow device hygiene checklist |
| T+7 days | Final payroll & benefits termination processed | People Ops / Payroll | Confirm COBRA notices and benefit vendor updates |

Special cases: contractors and consultants have accelerated 24–72 hour offboards depending on contract terms.

Manager and People Ops Playbook for Promotion & Role Changes

- Initiate: Manager submits Level Change Request form in People Ops portal at least 30 days before intended effective date.
- Calibration: People Ops coordinates a calibration meeting with peer managers and the leveling committee.
- Outcome: Documented decision, updated HRIS record, compensation update (if any) and communication plan.

Tools Matrix (what is provisioned by default)

| Category | Default Provision | Provisioned by | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Identity | Okta account, SSO groups | IT | Base groups depend on office and team |
| Communication | Slack, Google Mail/Calendar | IT | Auto-join #team channels on Day 1 |
| Code & Infra | GitHub org read access | IT | Write access by request |
| Monitoring & Alerts | Read access to Dashboards | Platform SRE | Full access requires manager approval |
| Payroll & Benefits | Payroll profile + benefits enrollment link | People Ops | Enrollment windows are time-bound |

Operational Metrics to Track

- Average time to full access (target < 48 hours).
- Percent of hires who enroll in core health plan within window (target > 95%).
- Time-to-first-merged-PR (target < 14 days for engineering hires).
- Offboard completeness rate (target 100% within 7 days).

Escalation and Exceptions

- For delayed device fulfillment: escalate to IT Director with subject "Device SLA breach: [name]".
- For benefits enrollment errors: People Ops escalates to benefits vendor manager and Finance (payroll) for manual adjustments.
- For security incidents discovered during offboard: open incident in PagerDuty and tag security@redwood.com.

Appendices

Appendix A — Example Onboarding Checklist (Manager-facing)

1. Before Day 1: Create first-week plan, team introductions, and set up mentor pairings.
2. Day 1: Verify access to Slack, repo, and calendar invite; introduce to buddy.
3. Week 1: Schedule product and architecture overviews; set 30/60/90 goals.

Appendix B — Short-term Contractors (provisioning differences)

- No corporate laptop unless requested and approved; use BYOD with device posture check.
- Reduced benefits eligibility: contractors do not receive health or retirement enrollment.
- Access is time-limited and reviewed every 30 days.

Appendix C — Common CLI snippets and templates

- Onboard bot example: onboard_bot create --profile "engineering" --start 2025-10-12 --manager "d.kim@redwood.com"
- Access request template (Jira): "Requesting write access to repo X for new hire Y. Manager: Z. Business justification: onboarding deliverables."

Ownership and Contacts

- People Ops (benefits & lifecycle): people-ops@redwood.com
- IT/Security (provisioning): it-ops@redwood.com
- Hiring Manager: owner listed in HRIS per record
- Escalations: director-people-ops@redwood.com, security@redwood.com

Revision history

- 2025-03-18: Created by Aisha Patel (People Ops).
- 2025-06-09: Added accelerated offboard process for contractors.
- 2025-11-02: Updated benefits enrollment window language and device SLA commitments.

End of document
